title: Cheesy Frittata with Indian Spices
description: A twist on the classic frittata, infused with Indian spices and flavors.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together 1 tablespoon light and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Brush the mixture onto the frittata.
3. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the frittata and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
4. Flip the frittata and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together 2 eggs and 1/2 teaspoon garam masala.
6. Pour the egg mixture over the frittata and sprinkle with shredded Brazilian cheese.
7. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until the eggs are set.
8. Remove the skillet from the oven and garnish with crumbly.
